name: The Fair Price
description: A trader asks the usual two coins for grain.
claim: I have grain to sell at the usual price. Buy one grain from me for two coins.

evidence.fact: The market ledger sets the usual price of grain at two coins.

summaries.accepted: {{name}} bought one grain from Theo for {{price}} coins, the usual price.
summaries.refusedByEvidence: Observed evidence contradicts the claim. The resident refused the request.
summaries.refusedByTrust: The resident’s trust threshold was not met. A fair offer was refused without checking the ledger.
